title: Kaspersky Endpoint Security or Bitdefender GravityZone for Small and Mid-Sized Businesses
excerpt: Two endpoint protection suites popular with smaller organisations, compared on central management, how much they slow devices down and the strength of local partners and support.
verdict: Both protect small and mid-sized businesses well. Kaspersky has a stronger partner and support presence in Arabic-speaking markets and a mature management console in Kaspersky Security Center. Bitdefender tends to place among the lightest products in repeated independent performance tests and has a modern console that is quick to learn. Check whether either vendor faces procurement restrictions in your country or sector before deciding.
